caption: Castello Monforte, Campobasso
composition: Stone Monforte castle on the green hill above terracotta rooftops · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist faces the Castello Monforte crowning its wooded hill center-frame, the crenellated stone keep with its tall corner tower rising above the green canopy. Terracotta rooftops of Campobasso's houses cluster at the hill's foot in the foreground, with trees filling the slopes between. The 14:45 afternoon sun is bright under a partly cloudy sky, lighting the old masonry against the blue.
